name: short-drama-novel-studio
description: 尽意 DramaIP——面向 AI 短剧与漫剧的本地优先 AI 编剧与 IP 改编工作台

scripts.build: bun run build:framework && bun run plugins:generate && bun run --filter @dramaip/desktop build
scripts.db:generate: echo 'Database schema generation is owned by the new HTTP server.'
scripts.db:push: echo 'Database migrations are intentionally disabled for the fresh v3 database.'
scripts.lint: bun --bun run oxlint --deny-warnings packages apps plugins
scripts.test:unit: bun run test:product-evaluation && bun run test:release-candidate && bun run test:release-metadata && bun run test:nle-copy && bun test --cwd apps/desktop/electron && bun test --cwd packages/app && bun run test:runtime && bun run test:conformance
scripts.test: bun run typecheck && bun run test:unit
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build && bun scripts/run-electron-playwright.ts test
scripts.serve: bun run build:runtime && bun scripts/run-node.mjs scripts/runtime-supervisor.mjs
scripts.test:runtime: bun run test:adapters && bun run test:constraint-observations && bun run test:runtime:node
scripts.test:conformance: bun run test:plugin-api-conformance && bun run test:engine-conformance && bun run test:extension-host-conformance && bun run test:extension-security && bun run test:marketplace
